body.name: Fixed SI endpoint-rule grammar
body.construction: \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\) is the grammar of monotone endpoint rules with finitely many typed vertex and regime placeholders. Premises may use any adjacency or unshielded-collider predicate in the complete \(U_k\)-level signature \(\mathcal O\), where every \(k\in[K]\) input is the signature of the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), including predicates whose vertices contain \(\zeta_k\), together with current observed-endpoint, uncovered-path, discriminating-path, membership in the observable certificate set \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)\), and reachability in \(L_{\mathrm{cert}}(\mathcal O)\); conclusions replace reported observed circles by tails or arrowheads. No rule premise may mention \(A(\eta)\), \(L_{A(\eta)}\), a member of \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), a realizability oracle, or a model enumerator.
